messages:
Ravi: FYI - Sunbeam (payments) wants to replace CompetitorZ with Redwood. They want a 10-day POC focused on chat parity + embeddings. Main asks: EU data residency, whitelisted IPs, and clarity on token billing deltas.
Tess: Can we give a pilot rate / credits? Their estimate ~3M tokens over 10 days.
Omar: We can offer €5k credits + 20% pilot discount if they commit to 2-month min after POC. Need finance sign-off.
Lina: Tech note: CompetitorZ returns streaming as JSON-lines with fields {id, chunk, done}. Redwood streams SSE events; we'll provide a small adapter that emits the same JSON-lines and preserves id. Also note our tokenizer counts ~7% different.
Ravi: Good. Also they rely on 1536-d embeddings; our recommended POC model yields 1024 dims. Can we provide a compatibility layer?
Lina: For POC we can pad vectors to 1536 by appending zeros and set a compatibility flag. Not ideal long-term but acceptable for evaluation.
Tess: Legal asked for an explicit parity disclaimer in the SOW. Also Sunbeam requested SLA language and a subprocessors list.
SecBot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec/sunbeam/q-2976 - SOC2 and encryption docs attached. Reminder set for 48h.
Omar: Ops can allocate eu-west-1 hosted deployment and provide CIDR list for egress. Note: permanent static IPs require Dedicated/VPC.
Ravi: Action items:
- Lina: deliver Node shim + test harness by Mon.
- Tess: draft SOW with pilot pricing and parity caveat by Wed EOD.
- Omar: publish CIDR list and runbook today.
Tess: Schedule sync Thu 9am CET to review results.
Ravi: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
